Voice Changer (Lite)

Have fun with your voice: pitch/speed shift, robot ring-modulation and echo on uploaded audio or mic recordings. Honest lite effects.

Mic recording stays in your browser.
Like tape: pitch and speed change together.

Lite = honest: pitch shifts speed too (tape-style), robot is ring modulation, echo is a simple delay. No formant-shifting magic is claimed. Everything runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload audio or record with your mic.
  2. Set pitch/speed, toggle robot and echo.
  3. Click "Apply effects" to render.
  4. Preview the result and download the WAV.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why is it called 'lite'?

Lite means honest: the pitch slider changes speed too (like tape), robot is ring modulation, echo is a simple delay. No pro formant shifting is claimed.

Can I record with my mic?

Yes — hold the record button, allow the microphone, and your recording is processed locally.

What format is the download?

WAV — always works, straight from your browser.
